historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (3.2% 5yr) diverges >30% from revenue (5.6%) and EPS (-1.9%): equity is suppressed by ~$0.55-0.8B/yr of buybacks and EPS by rising SBC, D&A and the FY2025 restructuring. Revenue CAGR selected as the cleanest organic series.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue FY2020 ($3,198.1M) and FY2022 ($3,616.7M) come from Akamai's 10-Ks; the Metrics.csv revenue column is blank FY2018-22. Owner FCF (reported FCF incl. capitalized software - SBC - equity-award taxes - interest income): FY2023 $178.5M, FY2024 $167.1M, FY2025 $45.3M. It is FALLING while company-defined FCF rose 6.3%/yr (618 -> 699) and revenue rose 5%: SBC + withholding taxes went from 10.3% of revenue (FY23) to 13.9% (FY25) and 19.6% in H1-26, so all reported FCF growth and more is being paid in stock. Owner-FCF 3/5yr CAGRs not computed: capitalized software is not in the CSV before FY2023.

scenario_narratives.base: The contracts ramp as signed. FY26 lands at the $4.49B guidance midpoint; the initial $1.8B frontier-lab deal, the $600M robotics deal and the expanded $11.6B Anthropic commitment take CIS from ~$0.5B to ~$2.4B by FY2030 and lift group growth to 16-17% in FY27-28 before it fades to 3%. Security keeps compounding high-single-digit while delivery shrinks ~5% a year. The price is ~$5.5B of front-loaded GPU/data-centre capex (FY27 capex two-thirds of revenue), so owner FCF is roughly -$1B, -$2.2B and -$1B in FY26-28 and only turns positive in FY29, funded by the May-2026 converts. At maturity EBITDA is 44.5% and SBC-plus-withholding 10.5%, giving a ~9.5% owner-FCF margin (~$0.8B) on ~$8.5B revenue. On contract economics the Anthropic deal is roughly value-neutral at an 8.5% cost of capital; the equity is small because $3.2B of net debt and a decade of SBC at 11-17% of revenue come ahead of it.
scenario_narratives.bull: Anthropic grows toward the ~$20B potential and other frontier labs and robotics customers sign on similar terms, so the same distributed capacity is re-let across a wider base. Group growth reaches 20-22% in FY27-28 and stays high-single-digit through FY30. Utilisation ramps faster than the 6-9 month lag and mature EBITDA reaches 48%. API security, Guardicore and LayerX cross-sell hold security near double digits. Capex is higher still (70% of revenue in FY27) but earns more per dollar. Customers prepay part of the build (+5% working-capital capture). SBC falls to 9.2% of a much larger revenue base. Terminal owner-FCF margin is ~12%. The warrant vests further (up to ~5%), which this build does not deduct.
scenario_narratives.bear: The AI capex cycle cools before the Anthropic capacity is fully used. The customer slows its ramp or renegotiates (it holds a warrant and a 7-year take-or-pay whose enforceability is untested), and the capex that is already committed earns thin returns. Group growth peaks at 9% in FY27 and slides to 2%. Delivery declines faster as big media and social customers keep moving to DIY. Security slows to mid-single digits against Cloudflare, Zscaler and Palo Alto. EBITDA sticks at 37.5-39% because GPU colo and power costs arrive before the revenue does. SBC stays at 12-17% of revenue to keep engineers. Working capital absorbs cash as receivables stretch. Terminal owner-FCF margin is ~5.7%, capitalised at 12x. In this case the $7.6B of converts takes the enterprise value and the equity is under water: a negative IV per share. That is a finding, not a rounding error, although limited liability floors a holder's loss at the price paid.

valuation_philosophy.summary: On the house basis (SBC and equity-award withholding fully expensed, share count flat) Akamai is worth a small fraction of its price. That was already true before the AI pivot: owner FCF was only ~$170-180M in FY2023-24 on $4B of revenue, because SBC plus withholding taxes (10-14% of revenue) consume nearly all of the ~$0.7-0.8B company-defined FCF. The Anthropic build then adds three years of deeply negative flows, funded with $3.5B of new converts. The market price sits far closer to the street basis, which treats comp as non-cash. So the valuation question is how much of Akamai's pay-in-stock an owner should ignore, not the AI deal.
key_risks_to_valuation: SBC treatment dominates: the street basis (SBC as non-cash) is several times the house value; band_position reports where the price sits between them.

Anthropic concentration: ~$5.5B capex and most FY27-30 growth tied to one customer that also holds a warrant for up to ~5% of the shares (only the ~2% said to vest immediately is in the count; strike undisclosed).
Refinancing: $7.64B of convertible principal is cash-settled; 2027 ($1.15B) and 2029 ($1.27B) maturities land in the peak capex years, and the 2033 notes are currently convertible.
Capex economics: at 65% EBITDA the $11.6B contract returns roughly its cost of capital; value creation needs renewal or expansion.
Delivery (30% of revenue) in structural decline; a faster fall compresses the high-margin core that funds the pivot.
Data vintage: Metrics.csv free_cash_flow omits capitalized internal-use software (~$300M/yr) and overstates FCF; this build uses the 10-K lines directly.
Anthropic deal terms come from the 24-Sep-2026 announcement via Analysis.json, not a filing; revenue timing, prepayments and warrant strike are unverified.

bridge.item: Anchor refresh: principal not carrying value of converts, LayerX $205M cash out, share count 153.69M GAAP diluted -> 150.13M economic (if-converted shares dropped because principal is deducted as debt; 2% Anthropic warrant added), H1-2026 owner-FCF add-back
Methodology: one 8.5% WACC and 2.5% terminal growth in every scenario (was 9.5/9.0/11.0 and 3.0/3.5/2.0), caps 16/18/12x, weights 25/50/25 (were 25/45/30); effects offset
SBC charge now includes equity-award withholding taxes ($123.8M FY25, $150.1M H1-26; prior said none was disclosed): SBC path ~12.5% -> 16.9% FY26 falling to 10.5%

Drivers re-judged: capex now includes capitalized internal-use software and the front-loaded ~$5.5B Anthropic build (FY27 66% of revenue); Anthropic revenue in FY27-28 growth (16-17% vs 11.5/10%); EBITDA margin restated pre-SBC 38.5% -> 44.5% (prior 26.5% -> 33% was the CSV's post-SBC EBITDA with SBC then deducted again, a double charge); D&A, bonus-depreciation cash tax and WC re-set

inputs.share_count_basis: Economic fully diluted, 150.13M = 143.591M basic outstanding at 30-Jun-2026 (10-Q balance sheet) + 3.673M dilutive stock awards (Q2-26 EPS note, treasury method) + 2.87M for the ~2% Anthropic warrant said to vest immediately (Analysis.json, 24-Sep-2026 announcement; strike not disclosed, so treated as fully dilutive). The 5.353M if-converted convertible-note shares in GAAP diluted EPS are EXCLUDED: principal is cash-settled and is deducted in full as debt, and the note hedges (strike = conversion price) offset the in-the-money excess on the 2033 notes ($93.01) up to the warrant strikes ($155+). The other ~3% of the Anthropic warrant vests against contract expansion; not in the count (a bull-case cost, noted in key risks). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows.
inputs.sbc_source: 10-K FY2025: cash-flow SBC add-back $459.402M (line 3670 area; note total 5470) + 'Employee taxes paid related to net share settlement of stock awards' $123.770M (financing, line 3723) = $583.2M. Akamai publishes no combined figure, so the two lines are summed per method. Cross-check: expensed SBC + CAPITALIZED SBC ($126.0M, non-cash supplemental line 3741, which escapes the cash capex line) = $585.4M, i.e. the summed basis approximates total grant cost rather than double-counting it. H1-2026: SBC $275.0M + equity-award taxes $150.1M + capitalized SBC $75.8M.
inputs.wacc_rationale: 8.5%, one rate for all three scenarios (risk is charged in the bear/bull flows and weights, not a second time in the discount rate). USD flows: US 10y ~4.2% + beta ~0.95 x 5.0% ERP = ~9.0% cost of equity; debt is ~32% of capital at market ($7.64B converts vs ~$16.6B equity) with a 0-1.125% coupon but a true (option-inclusive) straight-debt cost nearer 5% pre-tax / ~4% after tax -> ~7.4% textbook WACC, rounded UP to 8.5% because the capital structure is new, the $5.5B Anthropic capex is concentrated on one counterparty and the converts' cash-settled principal (2027: $1.15B, 2029: $1.27B) must be refinanced in the heaviest capex years.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases (colocation/PoP space, $1.78B liability at 30-Jun-2026) are rent inside cost of revenue and therefore inside EBITDA and the flows. Lease liabilities are NOT in net debt. One treatment, applied once.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (SKILL.md routing row 1: tech operating company - security, CDN, cloud/AI compute). 10 years because FY2026-28 owner FCF is deeply negative on the AI-capex build and the margin does not settle until ~FY2031. NO prior memory entry. Rebuilt 2026-09-25 from scratch at the caller's request (prior Sonnet-fallback version reconciled below). KEY CORRECTIONS vs the prior version: (1) reported FCF is OCF - purchases of PP&E - capitalized internal-use software ($311.7M FY25), i.e. $699.3M, NOT the Metrics.csv free_cash_flow of $1,011M which omits capitalized software (CSV FCF overstated every year FY2023-25 - flag for the financial-parser; capex in this build includes both lines); (2) equity-award taxes ($123.8M FY25, $150.1M H1-26) are real and now in the SBC charge; (3) one WACC across scenarios. NET DEBT: convertible PRINCIPAL $7,640.0M (all five tranches cash-settle principal; carrying value $7,562.8M) less cash + current + non-current marketable securities $4,616.3M at 30-Jun-2026, less the ~$205M LayerX cash consideration paid July 2026 = $3,228.7M. INTEREST INCOME ($70.8M FY25, $49.2M H1-26) stripped from last_fcf and absent from the forward EBITDA build because the cash pile is netted against the debt; cash interest paid (~$24M/yr) is left in, a small conservatism. TIMING: year 1 = FY2026 in full, but H1-2026 has already happened and sits in the 30-Jun balance sheet and share count, so its owner FCF (reported FCF 221.2 - SBC 275.0 - equity-award tax 150.1 - interest income 49.2 = -253.1) is added back in the equity bridge at the year-1 discount factor. BUYBACKS: an active repurchaser ($800M FY25, $616M H1-26, $564.8M authorisation left) - the flat count is funded, not a convention. ANTHROPIC: the 24-Sep-2026 $11.6B, 7-year commitment (up to ~$20B) with ~$5.5B of associated capex is one day old; its revenue is layered into FY2027-29 growth and its capex into FY2026-29 capex, per the contract economics management gave (60-70% gross margin ex-depreciation, 20-30% operating margin at full utilisation): 11.6B revenue x ~65% EBITDA ~= 7.5B vs 5.5B capex is a project IRR in the high single digits - roughly value-neutral at 8.5% before the warrant, positive only if it renews or expands.

base.growth_rationale: FY26 6.6% = guidance midpoint $4,488M. FY27 +16% / FY28 +17%: core (security ~+9%, delivery ~-5%) ~+3.3%, plus CIS going from ~$470M (FY26, '>=50%' guide) to ~$2.4B by FY30 as the initial $1.8B deal, the $600M robotics deal and the expanded Anthropic commitment (~$1.66B/yr at full run-rate) ramp with the 6-9 month lag. Management's pre-expansion 'low-teens 2027' is the floor; the expansion adds ~3-4pp. Then 8% -> 3% as the contracts mature; FY2035 terminal assumes the Anthropic capacity is renewed or re-let.
base.ebitda_rationale: EBITDA before SBC. FY25 41.2%, H1-26 38.6% (capacity-build costs ahead of revenue; Q3 non-GAAP op margin guide 24-26%). Mature 44.5% = core ~40% (delivery's high-margin decline offsets security scaling) blended with CIS at ~55% after its own opex (65% gross ex-depreciation).
base.sbc_rationale: Expensed SBC + equity-award withholding tax. SBC dollars scale with headcount, not with GPU revenue, so the % falls as Anthropic revenue arrives: ~$760M FY26 (16.9%) -> ~$800M FY27 -> 10.5% by FY35, above the 8.6-9.9% pre-FY24 expensed-only level because withholding is included.
base.capex_rationale: Purchases of PP&E + capitalized internal-use software. FY23-25 17.2-19.5%. FY26 ~40% guided before the expansion + first Anthropic tranche = 43%. ~$5.5B Anthropic capex front-loaded: ~$0.4B FY26, ~$2.3B FY27, ~$1.5B FY28, ~$0.5B FY29, on top of ~20-22% run-rate capex. FY32-33 bump = first GPU refresh. Terminal 21.5% vs D&A 20.5% (growth capex) - if anything light for a mix that is ~35% GPU compute.
base.da_rationale: D&A follows capex with a lag (6-year GPU/server lives): peaks ~30% of revenue FY29, falls as the FY27-28 cohort fully depreciates. Only affects cash tax in this build.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax on component EBIT. FY25 cash taxes $143.5M. 100% bonus depreciation on the GPU build (US OBBBA 2025) holds cash tax low FY26-28, then deferred taxes reverse; 23% steady state because withholding tax in the SBC line is not deductible, so component EBIT understates taxable income.
base.wc_rationale: Zero: receivables grew $172M in H1-26 against a $54M deferred-revenue build. No disclosed prepayment on the Anthropic contract.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 16x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% (above the 15% default): the thesis now rests on one counterparty that also holds a warrant, and on ~$5.5B of capex committed ahead of the revenue. Leverage roughly doubled in four months, and the first convert maturities (Sept-2027, Feb-2029) fall in the heaviest capex years. Base 50%: the contracts are signed and the guidance is recent. Bull 25% (below the 35% default): it needs the expansion toward $20B, new AI customers and faster utilisation to all happen, none of which can be observed yet, one day after the announcement.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
